brief.task: For this gene only, select and summarize zero to three supplied PubMed sources containing patient-relevant affected-human clinical evidence.

phenotype_context.information_content_note: Information content indicates phenotype specificity, not diagnostic importance.

selection_rules: Return at most three unique PMID evidence IDs and do not fill unused slots.
Do not perform term-by-term matching or select by the number of overlapping HPO terms.
Keep the affected-human gene relation and the clinical findings reported together in the evidence summary.
Summarize the source; do not assess candidate correctness, patient fit, specificity, or evidence strength.

selected_evidence.evidence_summary: two or three source-grounded sentences describing the affected-human gene relation and the clinical findings reported together; at most 800 characters
